episodes.synopsis: Security police officer Fukuzawa Yukichi arrives at work to discover that his client had been assassinated. The assassin is already apprehended by the time he arrives, but something doesn’t quite seem right.
episodes.title: The Lone Swordsman and the Famous Detective

episodes.synopsis: Fukuzawa gives Rampo a pair of glasses, claiming that wearing them would activate his ability to instantly determine the truth of any situation, and taking them off would give him the ability to tolerate the stupidity of the ordinary person.
episodes.title: The Day Is a Dream, the Night Is Real

episodes.synopsis: Rampo gets a ride to the police station, but the officer doesn’t seem to be who he says he is.
episodes.title: The Secret Founding of the Detective Agency

episodes.synopsis: Kunikida is being held for a murder that Rampo is certain he didn't commit. Meanwhile, Poe is determined to solve a murder mystery that has had the police stumped. Rampo has some thoughts on that situation, too.
episodes.title: A Perfect Murder and Murderer (1)

episodes.synopsis: The last page of the manuscript received by Poe appears to have been a photocopy. Rampo seems to know why, but there are still more mysteries surrounding the death of the author.
episodes.title: A Perfect Murder and Murderer (2)

episodes.synopsis: The Detective Agency receives an urgent request from the government to investigate a series murders perpetrated by the same culprit.
episodes.title: Tragic Sunday

episodes.synopsis: The Detective Agency is framed for the brutal murder of several government officials. Its members are on the run from the Military Police.
episodes.title: Dogs Hunt Dogs

episodes.synopsis: The president of the Detective Agency is arrested, and Kunikida is missing after having blown himself up with a grenade. Meanwhile, Atsushi and Kyouka are on the run, looking for a way to defeat the true mastermind: Fyodor.
episodes.title: You, A Child of Sin; I, A Child of Sin

episodes.synopsis: Port Mafia boss Mori wants Yosano to join them in exchange for assisting the Detective Agency through their crisis. Yosano reveals why she would rather not.
episodes.title: A Dream of Butterflies

episodes.synopsis: Tanizaki, Miyazawa and Yosano head to the site where Yosano is scheduled to be handed off to the Port Mafia.
episodes.title: In Lament of My Wingless Body

episodes.synopsis: Atsushi and Kyoka help Mushitaro escape. However, they get surrounded by the Bureau, led by Ango Sakaguchi.
episodes.title: Jailbreak

episodes.synopsis: Suspecting that Lucy is cooperating with the terrorist organization known as the Armed Detective Agency,  Jouno and Tetchou pay a visit to the cafe at where she works, in hopes of tracking down Atsushi and Kyouka.
episodes.title: Bungo Hound Dogs

episodes.synopsis: Teruko goes head-to-head with Sigma. Tachihara rethinks the Agency’s innocence after re-infiltrating the Port Mafia.
episodes.title: SKYFALL
